findings.title: Seed workflow can re-open global user RLS (USING true) in production and seed shared-password accounts
evidence: .github/workflows/seed-database.yml:85 CREATE POLICY users_select ON public.users FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true)
supabase/migrations/20260724000006_fix_database_p1_findings.sql:134-143 current policy scopes users to self + workspace co-members
.github/workflows/seed-database.yml:71 sets shared bcrypt hash for %@seed.test users
apps/web/lib/supabase/client.ts:18-20 browser uses anon key + user JWT, so PostgREST is reachable
findings.impact: Regresses tenant isolation on public.users so any authenticated user can read every tenant's emails, and can inject predictable-credential accounts into production.
findings.recommendation: Remove RLS DDL from seed-database.yml; apply policies only via migrations. Block production seeding or require a protected environment. Never embed a shared password hash in CI.

findings.title: Production provision job runs destructive Terraform with no environment approval
evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-production.yml:236-241 only the deploy job has environment: production
.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml:19-22 grants id-token: write without OIDC use
findings.impact: Any push to main can delete/recreate production infrastructure before any human approval runs.
findings.recommendation: Attach a protected production environment to provision/build-images, require plan+approval before apply, and drop unused id-token: write.

findings.title: IDOR: admin dead-letter retry is not tenant-scoped
evidence: apps/api/src/modules/admin/routes.ts:25-37 getAdminWorkspaceIds used by sibling routes but not here
apps/api/src/modules/webhooks/service.ts:461-494 loads dead letter by raw id and re-delivers
findings.impact: Any workspace admin can retry/trigger delivery of another workspace's webhook dead letter (cross-tenant action and existence probe).
findings.recommendation: Resolve the dead letter to its workspace and require it be within req.adminWorkspaceIds before calling retryDeadLetter.

findings.title: Cross-tenant user directory via auth service (service-role, unscoped)
evidence: apps/api/src/modules/auth/service.ts:44-53 searchUsers uses getSupabaseAdmin and ilike over all users
apps/api/src/modules/auth/service.ts:55-64 getProfiles uses admin client for arbitrary IDs
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can enumerate/search profiles and fetch arbitrary user ids across tenants (id, display_name, avatar_url); enables enumeration for phishing.
findings.recommendation: Scope these queries to the caller's workspace co-members or use the user-scoped Supabase client instead of the service-role client.

findings.title: infra-development destroys infra on every push to develop with weak controls
evidence: .github/workflows/infra-development.yml:4-8 triggers on push to develop for infra/**
.github/workflows/infra-development.yml:135-138 writes CI SSH key to /tmp and uses StrictHostKeyChecking=no
findings.impact: Destructive infra changes auto-apply without approval or least-privilege token scoping; disabled host-key checking allows MITM of deploy SSH.
findings.recommendation: Add permissions: contents: read, gate with a protected development environment, pin known_hosts, separate plan from apply.

findings.title: workflow_dispatch inputs interpolated directly into run: (script injection)
findings.impact: A user able to dispatch can inject arbitrary shell commands into the runner, reaching the job token and secrets.
findings.recommendation: Pass inputs through env: and reference shell variables; validate run_id/source_branch with a strict regex.

findings.title: Production web container receives the Supabase service-role key
findings.impact: The internet-facing web tier holds full DB privileges; any web compromise/leak bypasses RLS.
findings.recommendation: Remove SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY from x-common-env and inject it only into api and worker.

findings.title: 33 HIGH/CRITICAL dependency advisories risk-accepted until 2026-11-03
evidence: validate.yml:255-265 trivy fs severity HIGH,CRITICAL exit-code 1
pnpm-lock.yaml contains next, qs@6.15.2, body-parser@1.20.5, postcss, socket.io-parser@4.2.6, engine.io@6.6.9, fast-uri@3.1.3, brace-expansion, nanoid@3.3.13
findings.impact: Known-vulnerable runtime packages ship; both allowlists expire the same day, after which CI fails hard or teams widen the allowlist.
findings.recommendation: Land dependency upgrades before expiry; keep allowlist per-CVE with tracking issues; verify fixed versions against the trivy/audit DB.

findings.title: Auto-commit workflows hold contents: write and push to main
findings.impact: Self-modifying automation with write access to protected branches; generated commits can land without PR review and use [skip ci].
findings.recommendation: Use contents: read and open a PR, or restrict the bot with a narrowly scoped ruleset exception; do not skip CI on generated changes.

findings.title: Branch-protection CI gate only validates main; develop (auto-deploy) unchecked
evidence: validate.yml:273-323 branch-protection job hard-codes branch = 'main' and required rule types
findings.impact: False assurance: a misconfigured develop passes the gate; the rules endpoint may also fail under default token permissions.
findings.recommendation: Validate main, develop and release/**; declare explicit permissions for the check; map required status checks per branch.

findings.title: Webhook SSRF protection does not constrain redirects/DNS rebinding
evidence: packages/config/webhook-utils.ts:64-83 validates scheme and resolved IPv4 against private ranges
apps/api/src/modules/webhooks/service.ts:245-253 fetch(endpoint.url) follows redirects by default and re-resolves at delivery
findings.impact: A registered https URL can redirect/rebind to an internal address, causing SSRF from the API/worker network.
findings.recommendation: Reject 3xx with redirect: manual, pin the validated IP for the connection, and re-validate on every attempt.

findings.title: WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY not passed by production compose and not in .env.example
evidence: docs/environments/env-vars.md:88-94 documents the omission and that the key is required
findings.impact: Webhook create/update/delivery breaks in production, or a weak/unmanaged key is used.
findings.recommendation: Add WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY to docker-compose.prod.yml, .env.example, and the rotation guide.

findings.title: Container images pinned only by mutable tag
evidence: infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml and devremote.yml use the same mutable-tag pattern
apps/api/Dockerfile:4,27 and apps/web/Dockerfile:4,46 and apps/worker/Dockerfile:1,17 node:*-alpine
findings.impact: Non-reproducible, mutable deploys; tag retagging is a supply-chain vector.
findings.recommendation: Pin base and infra images by @sha256 digest and let Dependabot bump digests.

findings.title: 24 medium/low advisories are non-gating
evidence: DET-P2-003 and DET-P3-004 IDs are not present in .trivyignore
findings.impact: Medium/low CVEs accumulate without prioritization or visibility.
findings.recommendation: Add a non-blocking medium SARIF report and a scheduled triage.

findings.title: Dockerfile lint: unpinned apk and shell-form HEALTHCHECK
evidence: apps/web/Dockerfile:53,59 apk add --no-cache wget; shell-form HEALTHCHECK
apps/worker/Dockerfile:30,37 same; :35 EXPOSE 4001 while health uses 4100
findings.impact: Lower build reproducibility and stale/incorrect image metadata.
findings.recommendation: Pin apk versions, use exec-form HEALTHCHECK, fix worker EXPOSE to 4100.

findings.title: No actionlint/shellcheck gate despite known workflow lint findings
evidence: grep of .github/workflows/** finds zero actionlint references
findings.impact: Workflow YAML/shell regressions ship silently and are not gated.
findings.recommendation: Add a pinned actionlint job to validate.yml.

findings.title: Tracked shell scripts lack the exec bit
evidence: git ls-files -s shows mode 100644 for scripts/setup-dev.sh, scripts/test-db-rls.sh, scripts/check-sensitive-data.sh, scripts/hardening/run_all.sh, scripts/accessibility-audit.sh, scripts/audits/run_audit_cycle.sh, scripts/automation/run_full_pipeline.sh, scripts/teardown-dev.sh, tests/chaos/scenarios/api-crash.sh, tests/chaos/scenarios/redis-down.sh
findings.impact: ./script.sh fails on Linux/CI; Windows round-trips drop the bit.
findings.recommendation: git update-index --chmod=+x the intended executables.

findings.title: Deployment policy contradicts the development deploy workflow (DB changes)
evidence: docs/operations/deployment-policy.md:35-37 schema/RLS/seed never applied from a deploy workflow
.github/workflows/supabase-migrations.yml:3-8 auto-applies migrations on push to main/develop
findings.impact: Documented control is not matched by code; schema changes can reach environments without the stated gate.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the policy with the workflows or remove migrations from the deploy workflow.

findings.title: Admin /stats returns global cross-tenant counts
evidence: apps/api/src/modules/admin/routes.ts:59-69 users and messages counted globally; only workspaces/channels scoped to workspaceIds
findings.impact: A workspace admin learns platform-wide user/message totals (minor cross-tenant disclosure).
findings.recommendation: Scope all four counts to workspaceIds.

findings.title: Many workflows omit permissions: and rely on default token scope
evidence: No permissions: in supabase-migrations.yml, audit-ci.yml, audit-release-certification.yml, hardening-automation-runner.yml, governance.yml, platform.yml, load-test.yml, infra-development.yml, environment-promotion-audit.yml
findings.impact: Broader token than needed; increases impact of any script-injection or compromised dependency.
findings.recommendation: Set a repo default of read-only and add explicit least-privilege permissions block per workflow.

findings.title: SBOMs generated but not signed/attested; no license or dependency-review gate
evidence: No actions/attest-build-provenance, cosign, dependency-review-action, or license allowlist found in any workflow
findings.impact: No artifact provenance verification or license enforcement; SBOMs can be mutated after generation.
findings.recommendation: Add build provenance attestation, sign images/SBOMs, and a dependency-review/license gate.

findings.title: Containers lack runtime hardening beyond non-root
evidence: infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml services define no read_only, cap_drop, security_opt no-new-privileges, or tmpfs
apps/api/Dockerfile:55-56, apps/web/Dockerfile:64-65, apps/worker/Dockerfile:32-33 run as non-root (good)
findings.impact: Post-compromise/escape path is easier; larger container attack surface.
findings.recommendation: Add read_only, cap_drop: [ALL], security_opt: [no-new-privileges:true], and tmpfs for writable paths where compatible.
